title: I help businesses put AI to work.
And I can help build what you need.
intro.lead: This is what I've made: apps, games, websites and AI tools. Have a look around, and tell me if you want something like it. It has grown to more than 100 software projects on GitHub, public and private.

works.title: Selected works
works.note: The things I'm most glad I made.

catalogue.title: The rest of the catalogue
catalogue.note: Small things, fun things and a few very big ones.

services.title: What I can help you with

Cocode Guard.line: A small box by the router. Blocks bad sites and ads, and warns you about new devices and fake routers. 2,995 DKK installed.

Weather.line: The weather anywhere. Look up a city or let the phone find you, and see if the bike stays home today.

Metrologist.line: Estimate the size of a wall, door or window from one photo. Put a printed reference stick of known size against it and mark the corners.

SwanReady.line: My own AI agent for manufacturers who want the Nordic Swan Ecolabel. It goes through the requirements with you, one at a time.

Parvaz.line: Parvaz means flight in Persian. The app gives people in Iran a way around the censorship.

claude-email.line: I send an email with a task. An AI agent does the work and replies when it's done.

lpterapi.dk.line: A website for a couples therapist. Calm and simple, so the first step is easier to take.

Guard for Android.line: The companion app to Cocode Guard. Blocks bad sites and ads on the phone, even away from home. Free, no account, no tracking. You can download the first release from GitHub.

Battleship.line: Sink the battleships, just like you remember.

BabakCast.line: Fetch a video and get a summary.

BabakPlayer.line: The player for what BabakCast shares.

TMS Measurement.line: Measurements for transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) treatment. Works out the treatment site on the head from three measurements.

Claude Email App.line: Send tasks to claude-email from the phone.

FITS QR.line: FITS's contact cards as QR codes.

Markdown.line: Read and edit Markdown files on the phone.

7kasif.line: A card game for several players.

Dune.line: A strategy game in the browser.

Tetris.line: The classic block game in the browser.

Reverse Prime Plot.line: Prime numbers, drawn as a pattern.

Venus Høreklinik.line: Hearing aids and hearing tests in central Copenhagen.

Nick Autoteknik.line: A car repair shop in Rødovre.

Copenhagen Weather.line: The weather on the big screen.

Night Gallery.line: A gallery for the living room.

Breakout.line: The classic arcade game, with a UFO behind the wall.

Jev Bench.line: Measures how fast and how accurately AI models sort, and compares them.

graph-loop.line: AI agents that work on programming tasks without continuous supervision.

zjm-rag.line: Finds the file with the answer and answers from it.

MCP-servere.name: MCP servers
MCP-servere.line: Give an AI access to calendars, tasks and memory.

FITS.DK.line: Helps businesses write their IT security policies with AI. More than 3,000 hours of work.

Rådgivning.name: Advice
Rådgivning.line: Where does AI make sense for you, and where doesn't it? You get an honest answer and a plan you can use.

AI-agenter.name: AI agents
AI-agenter.line: Agents that do real work: they read, sort, reply and follow up. Built for your day-to-day.

Automatisering.name: Automation
Automatisering.line: A machine can often handle the dull work that eats your time. I find it and get it running.

paragraphs: My trade is building software. I've done it for more than 25 years, and today most of it is about AI: I advise on it, and I build with it.
Much of what you see here was made with the same AI tools I recommend to my clients. So I know what works in practice, and what only looks good in a slide deck.
You always talk to me. Not to a salesperson.

contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.lead: Tell me briefly what you're working on. I'll reply myself.
